items.title: Why Did Bloom Energy Stock More Than Triple In A Year?
items.summary: Bloom Energy (BE) stock gained 228% over the past year, against 16.7% for the S&P 500. The record second quarter it reported in July came late in that run. Over those twelve months Bloom took a business built on power for hospitals and factories and made it a supplier the major U.S. hyperscalers now approve. Today's price assumes that keeps paying.

The stock has gained 82.8% on a price basis over the past twelve months against 15.6% for the S&P 500, and still sits about 25% below its 52-week high. items.title: AI Power Stocks Rally After Generac's Deal For Amazon Data Centers
items.summary: Generac's Amazon agreement spotlighted an emerging growth lever as the rapid buildout of data centers offsets sluggish demand for home standby generators. The news also lifted several of Generac stock's electrical equipment and power management peers on Thursday.

items.title: Generac Surges 16% on $2.4B Amazon Data Center Generator Deal; Caterpillar Ticks Up, Cummins Sits Out the Rally
items.summary: Amazon just handed Generac a contract that sent shares surging, but buried inside the deal is a warrant arrangement that could let the customer claw back the very gains it created. Here is what the peer group silence from Cummins reveals about who actually wins.

items.title: Could Eaton Stock Lose A Third Or Gain Half In A Year?
items.summary: Eaton (ETN) shares trade near $398, and its options price a one-year range from about $268 to about $591. That spans a fall of about a third and a gain of nearly half. The width is no panic signal: it matches how hard this stock has actually moved over the past year. The business case rests on a factory build-out management calls its clear priority.

items.title: Generac Signs Amazon Generator Deal With $2.4B of Initial Deliveries
items.summary: GNRC lands a long-term Amazon generator deal with $2.4B of initial 2027-2028 deliveries, expanding its data center power business.

items.title: Is CAT Stock Safe At $780? Sizing Caterpillar’s Next Move
items.summary: Caterpillar (CAT) trades around $780. The market puts roughly a two-in-three chance that the stock finishes somewhere between about $525 and about $1,170 a year from now. That is not a forecast of direction. It is the size of the swing a holder is already carrying, and Caterpillar's own record says it is no exaggeration.
